## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(blocklist): add allow list`
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if this changes anything in `packages/*`; minor bump and a note for breaking changes while on `0.x` (see CONTRIBUTING.md#changesets)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs page updated (`apps/docs/content/docs/`)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
